{
  "reply": "Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear the Team plan didn't end up being the right fit.

Since your upgrade was 5 days ago, you're well within our standard 14-day refund window for new plan purchases, so I'd be happy to help process a full refund.

To get this sorted quickly, could you confirm:
1. The email address or account associated with the subscription (if different from this one)
2. The last 4 digits of the card used, or your invoice/order number (found in Billing > Invoices in your dashboard)

Once I have that, I'll submit the refund request to our billing team. Refunds typically show up on your statement within 5-10 business days, depending on your bank.

If you'd also like, let me know if there was anything specific about the Team plan that didn't work for you — it helps us improve, and I'm happy to see if a different plan might be a better fit down the line.

Looking forward to your reply so I can get this resolved for you.

Best,
Loopwise Support"
}
